name: Little Hole ~Ore no Musume ga Konna ni ... na Hazu ga Nai
original_name: りとるほーる ～俺の娘がこんなに……なハズがない
source: Naoto is happily married to his wife, Saki, and works long hours to support his family.  However, his young stepdaughter, Mion, has secretly lusted after him ever since they met, and starts to catch his attention.  One evening, Mion slips into his bed at night, and the two begin to carry out a sexual relationship behind Saki's back.
translation:
直人与妻子咲婚姻幸福，也一直努力工作养家。然而，年幼的继女美音从相识起便暗暗迷恋着他，并逐渐引起他的注意。

某天夜里，美音钻进直人的被窝，两人开始背着咲维持肉体关系。
